goal.text: The workshop lead gets a repair queue each morning with bench minutes and promised dates, so customers get a promised date the workshop can keep.
cites: [A:A01 "so customers get a promised date the workshop can keep"]

agent_checkable.metric: Promised dates earlier than the queue's bench time allows
agent_checkable.check: A script adds up bench minutes in queue order and compares each promised date (Q01).
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 a promised date is never earlier than the queue's bench time allows (blocker)."]

agent_checkable.metric: Brake or steering jobs behind another kind of job
agent_checkable.check: A script checks the queue order (Q02).

cites: [A:A01 "Nine promised dates in ten are kept, over a month."]
[A:A01 "No brake job waits more than one day."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Take the next job from the board.
cites: [A:A01 "Volunteer mechanics (users: take the next job from the board)."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Approves the queue before it goes on the board.
cites: [A:A01 "Workshop lead (approver: approves the queue before it goes on the board)."]

steps: The lead guesses the time for each job.
The lead writes cards on the board.
The lead phones customers with a date.
problems: About one promised date in five is missed.
Brake jobs wait behind slow wheel builds.
cites: [A:A01 "about one promised date in five is missed"]
[A:A01 "Out: parts ordering, sales of second-hand bikes, e-bike motor faults."]

inputs.description: Typed drop-off forms, about 15 a day.
inputs.format: plain text, one form per ticket
constraints: The customer's description of the fault
cites: [S:S01 §whole file]

glossary.meaning: The standard time a job takes, from the bench-time table.
cites: [A:A01 "Bench minutes: the standard time a job takes, from the bench-time table."]

glossary.meaning: Straightening a wheel so it spins without a wobble.

acceptance_tests.words: I give it a week of made-up forms, and no promised date is earlier than the bench time allows.
cites: [A:A01 "I give it a week of made-up forms, and no promised date is earlier than the bench time allows."]

ranks.what: Reference documents in the context pack
Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: The row quotes the form and the bench-time table line that decided it.
confidence.medium: A reputable secondary source; not expected here.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; such a row is marked 'ask the workshop' and raised as a question.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.

output.description: A repair queue, one row per drop-off form, in working order. A form with no fault description is refused as 'ask the customer'.
output.format: Table, one row per ticket, in queue order

fields.name: ticket
fields.description: The ticket number from the form.

fields.name: bike
fields.description: The bike as the form describes it.

fields.name: job_type
fields.description: brakes, steering, gears, wheels, punctures or other.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: One sentence, quoting the customer's description.

cites: [A:A01 "A form with no fault description is refused as 'ask the customer'."]

rules.statement: A promised date is never earlier than the queue's bench time allows.
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 a promised date is never earlier than the queue's bench time allows (blocker)."]

rules.statement: A brake or steering job goes ahead of every other job.
cites: [A:A01 "Q02 a brake or steering job goes ahead of every other job (major)."]

rules.statement: Every row quotes the customer's description from the form.
cites: [A:A01 "Q03 every row quotes the customer's description from the form (major)."]

rules.statement: Bench minutes come from the bench-time table, never a guess.
cites: [A:A01 "Q04 bench minutes come from the bench-time table, never a guess"]

bad.why: The promised date is earlier than the bench time allows.
A brake job is behind another kind of job.

risk.notes: The board keeps no history, so once the queue is written the old order is gone and can only be rebuilt from the forms. The mechanics and customers are affected.
cites: [A:A01 "Not reversible on the board"]
[A:A02 "Our customers, about seventy a week, and the eight volunteer mechanics."]
[A:A01 "Reads the typed drop-off forms."]

systems.description: The shared repair-queue board; writing the queue replaces its cards.
cites: [A:A01 "Writes the approved queue to the shared repair-queue board"]

gates.decision: Approve or reject the repair queue, directly before it is written to the board.
cites: [A:A01 "I approve the queue each morning, directly before it is written to the board."]

open_questions.question: Should e-bikes with no motor fault join this queue?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every promised date right on two made-up weeks of forms.
cites: [A:A02 "it should get every promised date right on two made-up weeks of forms"]
